# Starrfield Fun

Starrfield Fun is a portfolio of Starr, a UI/UX designer and developer.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://starrfieldfun.com/): introduction and selected work.
- [Work](https://starrfieldfun.com/work.html): five design and development case studies.
- [About](https://starrfieldfun.com/about.html): background and capabilities.
- [Photography](https://starrfieldfun.com/photography.html): editorial image gallery and colour correction.
- [Contact](https://starrfieldfun.com/contact.html): contact form.
